from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u032/system/state/workspace/programs/task-eee05b8a.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Uniform full rows and columns are the panel dividers.
    row_divs = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_divs + [len(grid)]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_divs + [len(grid[0])]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1) if row_bounds[i + 1] > row_bounds[i] + 1]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1) if col_bounds[i + 1] > col_bounds[i] + 1]
    # The most common non-divider color is the tile background.
    from collections import Counter
    divider_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in row_divs} | {grid[0][c] for c in col_divs}
    colors = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in divider_colors)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    result = []
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        out_row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            out_row.append(0 if count == 0 else background if count == 1 else 1)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
'''
p.write_text(code)
